source: ghanemja/behaviors (out/site/data.json) from NVIDIA SimReady, CC BY 4.0
principle: A rigid object on a slope slides when the slope exceeds atan(mu), and tips when the slope exceeds atan(d / h), where d is the distance from its centre of mass to the nearest support edge and h is the height of its centre of mass. Whichever angle is smaller decides.

validation.note: The measured tip angle reaches the 50 degree test-ramp cap for the share above, and the 'slides before it tips' test is true for nearly every object, so it cannot be checked on this data. Only the slip relation is tested.
